name: Content Generator — Ideogram + Sharp Compose → Telegram

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM content_plan WHERE status = 'pending' AND scheduled_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 2 ORDER BY scheduled_date, scheduled_time LIMIT 10
UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'generating' WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}' RETURNING *

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({"model": "gpt-4o-mini", "temperature": 0.8, "max_tokens": 600, "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": $json.auditor_system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": 'Plataforma: ' + $json.platform + '
Formato: ' + $json.format + '
Pilar: ' + $json.pillar + '
Tipo: ' + $json.post_type + '
Copy del post (en español, NO incluir en la imagen): ' + $json.copy_text + '
Idea base: ' + $json.image_prompt}]}) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE content_plan SET image_url = '{{ $json.image_url }}' WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'
UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'review' WHERE id = '{{ $('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.id }}'

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '✅ Aprobar', callback_data: 'aprobar_' + $json.id }, { text: '❌ Rechazar', callback_data: 'rechazar_' + $json.id }]] }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE content_plan SET telegram_msg_id = '{{ $json.result.message_id }}' WHERE id = '{{ $('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.id }}'
UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'error', error_log = '{{ $json.ocr_error_log }}' WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: '⚠️ Error OCR — post no procesado
📅 ' + $json.scheduled_date + ' | ' + ($json.platform||'') + ' — ' + ($json.pillar||'') + '
🔍 ' + ($json.ocr_error_log||'') + '
🆔 ' + ($json.id||'') + '

Acción: revisar en content_plan o resetear para reintentar.' }) }}
